_comment: Copy this file per design pass. Fill every field before writing any code. Delete this comment key when you save your copy.
brief_summary: <one sentence: the concrete subject, its audience, and the page's single job>

colors.name: <short token name, e.g. ink>
colors.role: <e.g. primary text | background | surface | border | accent (used once) | accent-secondary>

_colors_note: 4-6 entries total. Exactly one entry should carry role 'accent' unless the brief explicitly asks for a multi-accent system -- see the restraint doctrine in SKILL.md.

typefaces.used_for: <where this face appears: headline, hero number, etc.>
<captions, data, code, timestamps -- omit this entry if the brief has no such content>

_typefaces_note: Minimum 2 roles (display, body). Add the third only if the content actually has captions/data/code. The display and body face should not be the pairing you would reach for on any other brief -- name the specific reason this pairing fits this subject.

layout_concept.prose: <one sentence describing the structural idea, e.g. 'a single scrolling ledger of entries, each full-bleed, no shared grid'>

signature_element.description: <the one element this page will be remembered by>
signature_element.why_this_brief: <why this specific element embodies this subject, not a generic hero pattern>

self_critique.would_i_default_to_this_for_any_similar_: <yes/no, with the reasoning -- if yes, revise before continuing>
self_critique.revision_notes: <what changed after this critique pass, or 'none needed' with why>

_contrast_note: One row per foreground/background pairing that carries real text or a UI component. Use scripts/contrast-check.py to compute computed_ratio and pass before finalizing the palette.
_objective_lint_note: Fill this in by running scripts/lint-tokens.py against the built CSS/token output, not by hand -- see SKILL.md's objective lint pass section.
